memories.title: AI Chat App - Project Overview
memories.content: Building a cross-platform desktop chat app with AI features. Target: Windows and macOS. Key features: local inference via Ollama, cloud API fallback, conversation management, smart replies. Current phase: core Electron shell complete, working on LLM integration.

memories.title: Use JSON storage instead of SQLite
memories.content: Decided to use JSON file-based storage for v1 instead of better-sqlite3. Reason: better-sqlite3 frequently fails to compile on Windows due to node-gyp and Python build tool issues. JSON storage is simpler, works everywhere, and the Storage class has an adapter interface for future SQLite migration.

memories.title: Vite + Electron preload path resolution fix
memories.content: Fixed preload script not found error. Root cause: vite-plugin-electron outputs preload.js to dist-electron/main/, but the main process was looking in dist-electron/. Solution: configured vite build output to place all main process files in dist-electron/main/ and updated the preload path in BrowserWindow config to use path.join(__dirname, 'preload.js').

memories.title: UI Style - Apple Liquid Glass + Linear + Raycast
memories.content: User prefers Apple Liquid Glass design language combined with Linear's minimalism and Raycast's productivity focus. Key elements: frosted glass backgrounds, subtle shadows, thin borders, smooth animations, compact layouts, dark mode support. Avoid: heavy gradients, rough tables, pure black/white, default template looks.

memories.title: Effective Codex handoff prompt structure
memories.content: When handing off to Codex: 1) Start with 'Read AGENTS.md first', 2) Then read all handoff/ files, 3) Then explore src/ and tests/, 4) Never rebuild the project from scratch, 5) Preserve existing functionality, 6) Focus on UI polish, test coverage, performance, and build optimization. Always include a 'do NOT do' section.
